詞：Fio 楊千葵，Jenny 洪麗惠
曲：Matt 蔡岡廷

lines.a: 主祢是光明 照在黑暗裡
lines.b: Lord You are the light, changing darkest nights

lines.a: 全因祢憐憫 顯明祢旨意
lines.b: You've shown us Your heart, all through Your mercy

lines.a: 主賜我生命 恩典與真理
lines.b: Grace and truth You gave, a brand new life to me

lines.a: 成為神兒女 活出祢心意
lines.b: I'm now a child of God, and for Your will I'll live

lines.a: 犧牲自己 拯救我生命
lines.b: You gave Your life away just for me

lines.a: 榮耀君王 尊貴羔羊
lines.b: My glorious king, yet lamb of God
You paid the price for my sins

lines.a: 將生命氣息 吹入我心靈
lines.b: My savior, teach my spirit, How You'd breathe

lines.a: 進入祢愛裡 永恆的同在裡
lines.b: In Your presence, Lord, let Your love cover me

lines.a: 哈利路亞 聖潔羔羊

lines.b: Let all earth praise to my king

lines.b: My savior, teach my spirit, How You'd breathe

lines.a: 進入祢愛裡 永恆的同在裡
lines.b: In Your presence, Lord, let Your love cover me
